title: Xdrip with libre raw value in addition
body:
Dear Jamorham,

I‘m using xdrip+ with my libre sensor since a few days after having used Glimp for a long time. My mobile is a Samsung s5mini.

99% by scanning over NFC instead of using BluCon.

Now I miss the values and the line with the sensor raw values after scanning the libre over NFC.

Is there a chance to add the raw values to the diagramm and also in brackets behind the  measured bg-value?

Btw. Xdrip+ is a great „offline“ solution! So far, I didn‘t start using it online.

I hope you can help me with my question.

Trank you in advance!

Hi! With raw values, I mean the values from libre sensor read from nfc without any calibration. This helps to get a feeling about the real measured bg in the skin.... 

another question btw. How can I enable the Developer rights in xdrip+ in the options?

Thnx

xDrip shows the raw values in the bg data table. (go to settings->less common settings->enable databases to enable this option).
That said, libre sensor only stores the data for the latest 15 minutes, so you need to use the bluecon to get the values constantly.

To enable Engineering Mode, on the xDrip+ home screen tap the Treatment icon on the right side of the screen (this resembles a syringe). Then tap and hold the microphone icon on the bottom-right of the Treatment interface. In the text field that opens, type "enable engineering mode" and click Done. Engineering Mode is now enabled.

> xDrip shows the raw values in the bg data table. (go to settings->less common settings->enable databases to enable this option).
Hi, I was also interested in seeing the 'raw values' (i.e. direct from the sensor) but, when I looked in the xDrip settings->less common settings I don't see an "enable databases option".
Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Go to less common settings, then to advanced settings for libre 2, there you can activate to display the raw values in the graph

Ah sorry, just seen now, the question is not related to libre 2.
Can these raw settings be uploaded to Nightscout or better still can xdrip update every new raw setting ?
